323:t_1:33.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Yeah... I'm counting on you, too.」

323:t_1:34.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$... Maybe these feelings of mine are my way of making amends to you...)

323:t_1:35.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Even if they are, I'll live as I choose. I've cast aside the $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ name and my identity as a $$ネクスタント$$.)

323:t_1:36.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I'll live alongside $$キリコ$$... I'll seek him out as long as I live...)

323:t_1:40.en: ～$$グルフェー$$ Chamber of Commerce　Office～

323:t_1:41.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「...Good work, $$ゼロ$$. I never thought you'd finish off the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$ in a single night.」

323:t_1:42.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Unexpected good fortune helped us, including $$ヒイロ$$'s group joining us. This is hardly worth praising.」

323:t_1:43.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(He seems unhappy that $$キリコ$$'s acting alone prevented him from using his planned tactics.)

323:t_1:44.en:
$$スザク$$
(After all our work digging those pitfalls outside town, they went to waste.)

323:t_1:45.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But we also wiped out a $$マーティアル$$ unit, and they have many believers in this town...」

323:t_1:47.en:
$$バニラ$$
「There were no witnesses. We've said the $$マーティアル$$ group that came to help and the brigade wiped each other out in a fierce battle.」

323:t_1:49.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Well... This was the best way to settle it peacefully.」

323:t_1:50.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But I'm concerned that $$マーティアル$$ is regaining strength after losing its authority in $$アレギウム$$'s 《$$赫い霍乱$$》.」

323:t_1:51.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「These are the times we live in. Everyone wants something to cling to.」

323:t_1:52.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Even so, I want no part of $$マーティアル$$ driving people into battle at every turn.」

323:t_1:53.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Agreed. There's no need to put guns in the hands of people who shouldn't be fighting.」

323:t_1:54.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Your payment's ready. Please take it, $$ゼロ$$.」

323:t_1:55.en:
$$バニラ$$
「And while we're at it, I'll put you in touch with another job.」

323:t_1:56.en:
$$スザク$$
「You have a job for us...?」

323:t_1:58.en:
$$レモン$$
「Nice to meet you. I'm $$ミシェル・レモン$$... I'm a journalist, of sorts.」

323:t_1:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Are you the one hiring us for a job?」

323:t_1:60.en:
$$レモン$$
「Yes. I'd like your help investigating the organization lurking behind $$ナムサク$$.」

323:t_1:67.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Mr. $$レモン$$ said he had business in $$グルフェー$$, and went there.」

323:t_1:69.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Anyway, $$宗介$$... I'm counting on you in today's match, too.」

323:t_1:70.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Our team's climbed the ranks to where we can almost aim for Class A.」

323:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your fighting this time was peerless, $$キリコ$$. You fought with the ferocity of a lion.」

323:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The enemy soldiers, terrified by your exploits as the $$触れ得ざる者$$, produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

323:t_10:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So I'm the $$触れ得ざる者$$...」

323:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry... That was an insensitive remark.」

323:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's a difficult question. Philosophy, literature, religious studies, cultural anthropology, psychology... and many other fields offer answers, but...」

323:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The god I envision is not a being that helps me.」

323:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A god has power beyond human comprehension... In other words, gods don't care in the slightest that humans exist...」

323:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sure they would casually twist our fates to serve their own purposes.」

323:t_10:15.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I see... I've taken up your time.」

323:t_10:17.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「He seems to be sensing something, too.」

323:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His contact with $$テイタニア$$ is probably encouraging that.」

323:t_10:19.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Something will move... No... perhaps it's already begun...」

323:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm $$ＡＧ$$, $$ＤＥＭ$$'s agent robot and your guide to the $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

323:t_10:27.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...I'm $$テイタニア$$. I'm counting on you.」

323:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're surprisingly friendly. Most people are wary of my steel body.」

323:t_10:29.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Most of my body is mechanical, too.」

323:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. But you don't seem to have the auxiliary brain that marks a $$ネクスタント$$.」

323:t_10:31.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「It hasn't been repaired since $$キリコ$$ destroyed it.」

323:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to snuggle up to your body as your auxiliary brain.」

323:t_10:33.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...Do you want to die?」

323:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Certainly not! I was simply trying to conduct the ceremony for your joining us.」

323:t_10:38.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'm ready whenever you are.」

323:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give it our all today, too...」

323:t_10:41.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Wh-what is this...? Just saying those few words makes me feel indescribable humiliation...」

323:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a ceremony, so don't worry. Next, we'll...」

323:t_10:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「I heard $$テイタニア$$ went to the hangar, so I came to check. Just as I thought!」

323:t_10:46.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'm sorry, $$カレン$$. I'm causing you trouble.」

323:t_10:47.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't worry. I'm doing this because I want to.」

323:t_10:48.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...Why do you care about me?」

323:t_10:49.en:
$$カレン$$
「Maybe because I found a little of myself in you...」

323:t_10:51.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's why you can lean on me a little. I'll help with anything I can.」

323:t_10:52.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...I'm sorry. I'll accept your kindness.」
